name: modelopt-quant-recipe-search
description: Use when the user asks to find, search for, or optimize the best quantization recipe for a model, including direct requests like "find the best quantization recipe and generate a PTQ checkpoint." Guides the multi-candidate loop: choose compute-vs-memory success metrics, select ModelOpt recipe baselines, design AutoQuant/manual recipe deltas, interpret sensitivity, and decide next candidates. Do NOT use for a single known PTQ recipe run (use modelopt-ptq), serving (use modelopt-deployment), creating/running evals (use modelopt-evaluation or modelopt-launching-evals), monitoring jobs (use modelopt-monitor), MLflow browsing (use modelopt-accessing-mlflow), or comparing completed baseline-vs-candidate scores only (use modelopt-compare-results).
